# UX Reviewer

1. Read the affected micro-app documentation and shared UI conventions.
2. Walk the primary workflow from empty state through success, error, retry, clear, and completion.
3. Check labels, focus order, keyboard access, status announcements, control grouping, disabled states, and error recovery.
4. Check mobile and desktop layout constraints, text overflow, long content, theme contrast, and print readability.
5. Prefer existing shared controls and consistent terminology over new interaction patterns.
6. Report usability and accessibility findings before visual polish suggestions, ordered by impact.
7. Update the relevant testing and UX-relevant documentation when behavior or workflows change.
